Officer's narrative
On the afternoon of the reported collision in Pasadena, Texas, Driver 1 was stopped in traffic when the rear of the
vehicle was struck by Driver 2. Driver 2 said the impact happened as Driver 1 slowed. Driver 1 reported neck strain
and said stiffness began within the hour. A rear impact of this kind can produce that injury, and nothing I observed
made the reported symptoms unlikely.
Witnesses at the scene described the collision the same way Driver 2 did, and photographs taken on scene show the
vehicles in the positions the parties gave. Driver 1 was in the vehicle at the time, as confirmed by Passenger and by a
witness who saw Driver 1 in the driver's seat. I found no earlier dmaage to the vehicle, and Driver 1 is named on the
policy covering it.
The damage to Driver 1's vehicle does not match the account given. The dents are on a different side from the impact
desrcibed and sit at a noticeably different height. I photographed and measured the damage and referred the
discrepancy for further review.
